title: The Peninsula Family Day Out
dek: The gondola, a brewery lunch and a bay beach, with a final coffee stop if the family still has the energy. Four stops you can shorten to three.

bookingChecklist.item: Check lunch service and cafe opening hours

stops.note: Start high. The Arthurs Seat Eagle gondola is the anchor of the day  -  twenty minutes of gently dangling flight and the best orientation to the whole Peninsula.
The right family lunch room: grass, picnic tables, a wood-fired pizza oven, and a tasting flight for the adults. Do not try to upgrade to a cellar door.
Make the beach the afternoon pause. Choose whether to swim after checking the day's conditions, and supervise children near the water.
An optional coffee stop on the way north. Check the closing time before leaving the beach; skip it if the day has run long.

heroImage.alt: Arthurs Seat lookout over the bay

editorNote: Give the day two anchors: the gondola and lunch. The beach can be a short wander or a longer pause, depending on the conditions and the children's energy. The final coffee is optional. Check tickets, food service and opening times before leaving home rather than treating the four stops as a fixed timetable.
